verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a workflow-automation platform, but the evidence pack never documents a way to self-host Zapier's core engine. Everything describes a hosted service ('no infrastructure'). Running the SDK, CLI or a local MCP server only gives client-side access to the hosted platform and earns no credit for self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
